hooks.command: changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$changed" ] && exit 0; echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(core/|senses/|skills/|shared/|bench/|ui/|SPEC\.md|ROADMAP\.md)' || exit 0; echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(PROGRESS\.md|DECISIONS\.md|docs/ARCHITECTURE\.md)$' && exit 0; jq -n --arg m "Commit touched core/senses/skills/shared/bench/ui or SPEC.md/ROADMAP.md but not PROGRESS.md, DECISIONS.md or docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Update them if this was a phase-end or a real architectural decision; otherwise ignore." '{systemMessage:$m,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'

changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD 2>/dev/null); echo "$changed" | grep -q '^shared/types.ts$' || exit 0; git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- shared/types.ts | grep -qE '^\+\s*\|\s*"[A-Z_]+"' || exit 0; echo "$changed" | grep -q '^CLAUDE.md$' && exit 0; jq -n --arg m "shared/types.ts's Capability union changed in this commit but CLAUDE.md was not touched. Every capability tier decision (green/yellow/red) is recorded in CLAUDE.md section 5, matching the APP_CONTROL/REMINDERS/POINTER_CONTROL precedent -- update it now if this added a real new capability, or ignore if this was just a comment or reorder." '{systemMessage:$m,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'
hooks.statusMessage: Checking whether a new capability needs recording in CLAUDE.md...
